{{Quote|I've spoken&mdash;at a safe remove&mdash;with a pirate from the Fair Hollis system who lacked the ability to see other organic beings as anything other than objects ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki></nowiki>|Hali Ke's internal memorandum|<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-7-the-grand-army-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 7 &mdash; The Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>}}
The '''Fair Hollis system''' was located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|205|Ke, Hali}}</ref> [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticist]] [[Hali Ke]] interviewed a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified pirate (Fair Hollis system)|pirate]] from the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. In an internal memorandum composed that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Ke noted that the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] was only able to view other [[Species/Legends|organic beings]] as objects, to the detriment of anything else.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fair Hollis system was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the sidebar that would have mentioned the star system was cut before the book's release.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The information regarding the system was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Fair Hollis system in grid square Q-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
